newsitem.title: USA: NAPM-New York business conditions 51.0 in March.
newsitem.headline: NAPM-New York business conditions 51.0 in March.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) index of New York-area business conditions fell to 51.0 in March from 53.9 in February.
The New York-area non-manufacturing conditions index also fell, to 51.6 in March from 54.8 the month before.
Manufacturing-sector conditions rose slightly, to 46.0 from 45.9, the report said.
An index above 50 denotes growth, NAPM said.
"The decisively negative business environment that began in February for manufacturers continued in March," it said.
"Looking forward to the upcoming six months, purchasers' optimisim slipped in March," NAPM said.
NAPM's New York business outlook index, which looks ahead about six months, read 64.6 in March, the lowest level since last October, the report said.
